text:
sales-alex: Heads-up: Orion Logistics (enterprise supply chain) wants a private on-prem deployment with VPC networking and an air-gapped option. HSM required. They asked for feasibility, a target timeline (~3 months), and a dependencies checklist. Sharing initial ask here.

marta: can you paste the reqs you got from their infra team?

sales-alex: From the discovery call: 2x A100 nodes (or equivalent), peak 100 QPS, sustained ~25 QPS, model is Llama-3-70B quantized, data must never leave customer network, HSM for key management (PKCS#11), audit logs retained 12 months, SOC2/PCI considerations, support window maybe 24/7. They want go-live in ~10 weeks if feasible.

jonah: key infra deps we should call out: HSM integration (PKCS#11), model storage (NFS/CEPH or S3-compatible object), GPU drivers and firmware approvals, kernel + container runtime versions, offline installer for airgap, local logging/metrics sink, and a way to ingest audit logs into their SIEM. Also need to confirm network egress constraints — they may allow zero outbound except for a short bootstrap.

eva-ng: From model side: 70B with full KV cache will stress memory. Quantized 4-bit helps but we need to validate our quant pipeline and runtime kernels on A100. Expect 4-6 weeks for compilation, perf runs, and regression checks (includes eval prompt set).

deploy-bot: preflight-1767777777 created. Checklist items: network matrix, HSM certs & vendor driver, infra sizing doc, license agreement, SOC2 scope, offline-installer validation, staging deployment.

sam-pt: risk flags to track: 1) HSM driver compatibility across vendor models 2) complexity of an airgapped installer & upgrade path 3) procurement lead times for GPUs/HSM 4) SLAs — 24/7 support increases operational burden.

sales-alex: they requested Sep 15 go-live (~10 weeks). If we parallelize model validation + procurement, can we make it?

marta: procurement lead time for new HSMs/A100 cages can be long. Suggest a two-phase proposal: Phase 1 = Dedicated staging in our DC with VPC-only access + customer-managed HSM in a co-lo (fast demo), Phase 2 = full airgapped on-prem rollout. This reduces risk and shortens initial delivery.

jonah: agreed. Action items (initial): - @eva-ng: perf & risk estimate due Wed - @marta: vendor procurement + timeline by EOD Tue - @security-lead: confirm audit log schema and offline audit options - @sales-alex: get exact support window and escalation path from customer

security-lead: I need their SIEM schema and retention policies. Also confirm whether they accept an offline audit connector or require live log forwarding. I'll draft required fields and send a template.

sales-alex: customer Qs to answer: 1) Can we support BYO-HSM or must we supply? 2) Is an offline installer acceptable and do they need signed binaries? 3) Can we mount their existing NFS/CEPH for model artifacts? I'll collect and post answers.

eva-ng: quick perf note: 70B quantized to 4-bit on A100 (w/ our runtime kernels) ballpark ~18-25ms per token single-stream, with batching could improve latency/throughput tradeoffs. KV cache memory pressure unknown until we run sample traces; I'll include a perf matrix with memory, latency, and throughput for 1/2/4/8 token context.

jonah: network config we require for non-airgap/staging (example):
```
Allowed outbound endpoints: telemetry.redwood-internal.net:443 (strictly for telemetry, cert-pinned)
Ports (customer -> node): 443/TCP (control plane ingress)
  50051/TCP (internal grpc, optional)
  22/TCP (maintenance, optional & timeboxed)
Internal: NFS (2049/TCP) or S3 endpoint over 443
HSM: PKCS#11 over local network, ensure VLAN isolation and MTU settings.
```

marta: I'll draft a short PRD with milestones (Week 0: procurement & infra prep, Week 2-4: model onboarding & perf, Week 5-7: staging deploy + security validation, Week 8-10: on-prem rollout & handoff). Will share tomorrow.

sales-alex: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. Let's sync for 30m after stand to confirm owners and timeline.
